review_notes: Resolve a reference nested inside the final allOf schema entry. The last composed schema is skipped by recursive traversal. Resolve every composed child along with properties/items/not references in the original order. Original F2P/P2P unchanged. Baseline diagnostic failure is expected task reproduction, not a policy error. Source imports asserted against the workspace before and after the repair.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/apispec/core.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('apispec.core')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from apispec import APISpec
spec=APISpec(title='demo',version='1',openapi_version='3.0.3')
spec.components.schema('Pet',component={'type':'object'})
value={'allOf':[{'type':'object','properties':{'pet':'Pet'}}]}
spec.components._resolve_refs_in_schema(value)
print('composed_schema_reference',value)
assert value['allOf'][0]['properties']['pet']=={'$ref':'#/components/schemas/Pet'}

PYREPLAY
